description: This Java class 'AuthService' provides authentication services, including registration and login functionalities, for a backend API. It interacts with user management and JWT token generation components.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class managing user registration and authentication, integrating user management and JWT token generation.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating a new user and generating a JWT token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, then generates and returns a JWT token upon successful login.
